relative_igg_fc_binding_fitness.instruction: Predict the relative IgG-Fc binding fitness in the Wu et al. GB1 four-site assay. The remaining GB1 background is fixed to the assay reference; the reference residues at positions 39, 40, 41, and 54 are V, D, G, and V. Fitness is normalized relative to this reference.
relative_igg_fc_binding_fitness.field_description: residues_at_positions_39_40_41_54: Four standard amino-acid one-letter codes in that position order.
